findings.title: include_website_name missing ? so conditional never runs
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb the method is defined as `def include_website_name` without a question mark. ActiveModel::Serializer checks `include_<attr>?` (as used for `include_email?`, `include_stats?` in the same file), so this method is never called. As a result `website_name` is always serialized even when `website` is blank, returning nil instead of being omitted.

findings.title: website_name leaks website hidden for TL0 users
findings.body: The serializer hides `website` for TL0 users seen by anonymous via `untrusted_attributes`, which returns false when `scope.restrict_user_fields?` is true. `website_name` was added to `attributes` but was not added to `untrusted_attributes`, and its include check only tests `website.present?`. An anonymous viewer of a TL0 profile will therefore still receive `website_name` containing the website host and path, defeating the hiding of `website`.

findings.title: untrusted attributes test omits website_name
findings.body: The spec's `untrusted_attributes` list in spec/serializers/user_serializer_spec.rb does not include `website_name`, so the test that verifies TL0 attributes are hidden from anonymous users cannot catch the leak of `website_name` described above.
